newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average off more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average off more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points on Thursday as investors paused to take profits after three straight sessions of gains totaling 265 points.
At 11:17 a.m. EDT, the Dow was down 50.17 points at 6,958.82, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limit on program trading.
